title: 第205章 任务七玄阴扇第204章 潘鸿出关
content_zh:
“赚取贡献点？”
马继章很快反应过来：“是为了进入阴灵长河修炼吧？”
顾景元点头：“是的。阴灵长河的环境与我的功法、体质很契合，在里面修炼，进展很快，所以想尽快赚取足够的贡献点，继续前往修炼。”
马继章点了点头：“嗯，我得提醒一句啊，阴灵长河待久了，容易被阴煞入体，侵蚀根基。最好是修炼一段时间，中间找人双修炼化。”
顾景元：“多谢长老相告，弟子有分寸。”
“嗯，接任务的话，来这边看看吧。”
马继章将顾景元带到一面巨大的墙壁旁边，上面挂满了各种玉简，都是各种任务。
顾景元点头，神识扫去，各种任务信息出现。
“悬赏七叶血芝或者相关消息，贡献点一百到一万，二阶中品法器一件.....”
“相助炼制二阶上品法器，五百贡献点，两千灵石，要求筑基六层或者筑基后期修为，起码能炼制二阶中品法器.....”
“悬赏二阶下品金翅鹰的培育路线，一千贡献点......”
“.....“
任务很多，也很杂。
但顾景元只关心贡献点，对于其他的法器、灵石、功法秘籍，甚至丹药都不在乎，所以一瞬间筛选出大半不合适的。
而剩下的任务里面，以他筑基一层能做，而不会让人太过于怀疑的，也不是很多。
最终，顾景元选择了四个任务。
二阶中品蟒类妖兽脊骨；
寻找三纹炎阳花；
辅助炼制二阶中品法器，要求修炼阴寒类属性功法；
炼制丹药。

前面两样，他此刻储物袋中就有，都是之前的战利品，顾景元将大部分用不上的资源都给了分身这边。
辅助炼制二阶中品法器对他来说更加没有难度，他虽然是筑基一层，可神魂强大，本体也是能炼制二阶上品法器的，即便此刻只是分身，可辅助炼制并不难。
炼制丹药也是一样，对他来说不难。
将任务接下，马继章这边也还是登记了一下。
顾景元直接拿出二阶中品蟒类妖兽脊骨和三纹炎阳花，直接完成前面两个任务。
两个任务，七百贡献点直接到账。
随即顾景元前往炼器堂。
三个时辰后，顾景元抵达炼器堂外，拿出任务令牌之后，跟随进入炼器堂中。
“筑基一层？这不胡闹吗？”
炼器堂，一间巨大的石室之中，一位满脸络腮胡，体型壮硕，赤裸上半身的男子看向顾景元皱眉开口。
顾景元也知道自己的修为会引来质疑，当即开口道：“见过长老，我虽然是筑基一层，可早就能炼制二阶下品法器了，长老若是不相信，我可以示范一番。”
“哦？这么有自信？好，那你试试。”
content_en:
"Earn contribution points?"
Ma Jizhang quickly reacted: "Is it to enter the Yinling River to practice?"
Gu Jingyuan nodded: "Yes. The environment of Yinling River is very suitable for my skills and physique. I am making rapid progress while practicing there, so I want to earn enough contribution points as soon as possible to continue practicing."
Ma Jizhang nodded: "Well, I have to remind you that if the Yin spirit stays in the river for a long time, it is easy for the Yin spirit to enter the body and erode the foundation. It is best to practice for a period of time and find someone to practice with you in the middle."
Gu Jingyuan: "Thank you, elder, for telling me. Disciple, please be sensible."
"Well, if you accept the mission, come here and take a look."
Ma Jizhang took Gu Jingyuan to a huge wall, which was covered with various jade slips and various tasks.
Gu Jingyuan nodded, his consciousness swept away, and various mission information appeared.
"A reward for Seven-leaf Blood Mushroom or related information, contribution points of one hundred to ten thousand, a second-level mid-grade magic weapon..."
"Help me refine a second-level high-grade magic weapon. Five hundred contribution points and two thousand spirit stones. It requires six levels of foundation building or a later stage of foundation building. I can at least refine a second-level mid-grade magic weapon..."
"A reward for the cultivation route of the second-level low-grade golden-winged eagle, one thousand contribution points..."
“…”
The tasks are many and complex.
But Gu Jingyuan only cared about contribution points and didn't care about other magic weapons, spiritual stones, skill secrets, or even elixirs, so he screened out most of the inappropriate ones in an instant.
As for the remaining tasks, there aren't many that he can do at the first level of foundation building without making people too suspicious.
In the end, Gu Jingyuan chose four tasks.
A second-level mid-grade python-like demonic beast spine;
Looking for the three-striped Yanyang flower;
To assist in refining the second-level mid-grade magic weapon, it requires practicing Yin-cold attribute skills;
Refining elixirs.
He had the first two in his storage bag at the moment, both of which were trophies from before. Gu Jingyuan gave most of the unused resources to the clone.
It is not difficult for him to assist in refining a second-level mid-level magic weapon. Although he is at the first level of foundation building, his soul is powerful, and his body can also refine a second-level high-level magic weapon. Even if he is just a clone at the moment, it is not difficult to assist in the refining.
The same goes for refining elixirs, it's not difficult for him.
After taking over the task, Ma Jizhang still registered it.
Gu Jingyuan directly took out the second-level middle-grade python monster spine and the three-stripe Yanyang flower to complete the first two tasks.
For two tasks, 700 contribution points will be credited directly to your account.
Then Gu Jingyuan went to the weapon refining hall.
Three hours later, Gu Jingyuan arrived outside the Weapon Refining Hall. After taking out his mission token, he followed him into the Weapon Refining Hall.
"Building the first level of foundation? Isn't this nonsense?"
In the weapon refining hall, in a huge stone room, a man with a beard, a strong build and a bare upper body looked at Gu Jingyuan and frowned.
Gu Jingyuan also knew that his cultivation would arouse doubts, so he immediately said: "I have met the elders. Although I am only at the first level of foundation building, I can already refine second-level low-grade magic weapons. If the elders don't believe it, I can demonstrate it."
"Oh? So confident? Okay, then you try."
